author: Helpful-Series132

replies.author: jfpforever
replies.body: why are you shilling anti ai in this sub? This whole AI hatred thing is so hypocritical. And I know its the same people who are on the losing end of it all of a sudden. The same one's who would post comments about how "im not building your game for a part of the profits." or "im not building your next facebook."  I've seen tons of those comments through the years. But guess what? AI will. And they dont need a cut! You all failed to realize that not everyone had the time or headspace to learn new things to build them on their own. And instead of helping them you laughed at them. But now you are the one being cut out. And you dont like it. now you know how they felt. And there is a big difference between AI slop, a term you've latched onto to make yourself feel good, and AI developed. Learn which is which.

comments.body: There's a lot of AI crap atm. Doesn't mean it can't be good. I'm a real gamedev for 15 years and use AI to speed up my work (art, models, dialogue and code). People can't distinguish it as AI.

replies.body: AI vibe coding makes people believe they are real coders or real game designers. The results are there but they're not good. Real gamedevs, especially in Asia, already use AI in their real workflows.
